scope: Actual Effect deployment targeting, Force cost, required destiny, success/failure/empty Reserve, astromech loss, continuous nav cancellation and capacity, actual Alter cancellation.
method: Controlled ships, aboard droids, characters, Force and top destiny cards; real Effect deployment and Alter cancellation through the engine decisions.
Destiny is sampled at COMPLETE_DESTINY_DRAW. Fixtures assert deployment/Alter settlement and one Force deployment cost.
All seven rows replay through serialized native commands. Six agree exactly; capacity row preserves the recorded GEMP discrepancy. Native uses actual droid deployment before Alter.

divergences.gemp: After successful Alter, Red 6 has zero astromech capacity but its droid remains attached; no placement in Used occurs.
divergences.native: Restored navigation removes the added slot; without ordinary passenger space the droid is placed on top of Used.
divergences.authority: AR p89 Starships — capacity — lost capacity, and p147 I’ve Lost Artoo ruling.

limitations: Component verification only; production admission remains false. Full catalog, targeting/loss prevention, navigation grants, sectors and the remaining engine/product scope remain.

GEMP aboard placement in capacity rows is controlled; actual droid deployment, excess-droid selection, ordered attached-card loss, canceled draw and recovery receive additional native tests, not distinct oracle claims.
End outcomes do not claim complete equivalence of every intermediate GEMP response window. Permanent astromech variants are outside the currently implemented vessel set.
